edges.description: Loss of SETD1B methyltransferase activity is expected to reduce H3K4 methylation at its target loci.
Generalized epileptiform activity occurs in some individuals with pathogenic SETD1B variants, although the intervening circuit mechanism remains unresolved.

This inferred transcriptional disruption provides a plausible route from SETD1B loss of function to impaired nervous-system development.
